en.title: FAR 25.205(c): should the minimum consideration for a postaward exception cite 25.204 directly?
en.summary: FAR 25.205(c) sets the minimum consideration for a postaward exception based on unreasonable price by reference to the amount “established in 25.202(a) or in accordance with agency procedures”. Paragraph 25.202(a)(3) sets no amount; it points onward to 25.204, which adds 20 percent of the cost of the foreign construction material. Clauses 52.225-9(c)(2) and 52.225-11(c)(2) state their own minimum by reference to the evaluation factor in each clause. One reading takes the reference to 25.202(a) to reach the 25.204 factor through (a)(3). The other reads 25.202(a) as naming no amount, so that the minimum comes from agency procedures or the clause.
en.impact: No contract with a different consideration amount under either reading has been established.
en.correction: Please consider whether 25.205(c) should cite 25.204 directly.

quotes.text: adequate consideration is at least the differential established in 25.202(a) or in accordance with agency procedures
The contracting officer concludes that the cost of domestic construction material is unreasonable in accordance with 25.204.
the contracting officer shall add to the offered price 20 percent of the cost of any foreign construction material proposed for exception
adequate consideration is not less than the differential established in paragraph (b)(3)(i) of this clause
